From the showroom

Check the history yourself

Most used cars sold in Cyprus are Japanese and British imports. Independent online sources let you verify mileage history and body condition before you buy. All you need is the chassis number or the UK registration.

Imported from Japan

carvx.jp gives a detailed report with mileage history, previous use and body condition, about 20 to 25 euros, ready in one working day. japanstat.com and jpsheet.com are instant, about 5 euros, and show the last auction.

Imported from the UK

checkthecar.com checks the mileage history for free; a full history report costs less than 10 euros.

Direct contact is advisable

D. Mandilas Car Sales has been in Livadia since 1985, on the Larnaca-Dhekelia road next to Jumbo. In the words of the dealership: it is not about finding your perfect car, it is about taking care of your needs and wants. Have a chat, let them guide you.
